truths.truth: With ESC and BEL archived in a tool result, human output of search, the show --before/--after window and header, and observations holds no 0x1b or 0x07 byte and shows \u001b and \u0007 where they were, including a control planted in a turn's time and a tool name
truths.evidence: Call sites: search.rs:147-149 (day, file name, project) and :152 (excerpt); show.rs:110-112 (header ts, file name, project), :161-162 (window label and text), :174 (continues_from); observations.rs:266-267 (file name, branch), :282 (six fact lists), :292 (truncated). On HEAD, `cargo test -p terminus --all-features --test recall_cli archived_control_characters_print_escaped_in_search_and_show` and `--test observations archived_control_characters_print_escaped_in_the_listing` each report `1 passed; 0 failed`. Independent probe (/tmp/claude-1000/-code-terminus/37a5a5ca-e9b1-48a6-9242-56fd27975cc1/scratchpad/probe.py, HEAD binary on a scratch store): show header printed `2  2026-10\u001b19T12:00:00.000\u0007Z  planted\u001bfile.jsonl  .../planted\u001bproject`, window printed `assistant/Ba\u001bsh` and `\u001b]52;c;aGVsbG8=\u0007 quixotrel`, and search, show header+window and observations stdout held no raw control byte. Record type cannot carry a control: parse/record.rs:17 TURN_TYPES admits only user, assistant, attachment, system.

truths.truth: Exactly the 63 code points U+0000-U+001F minus tab and newline plus U+007F-U+009F print as lowercase \u00XX; tab, newline, U+200B and U+202E print unchanged
truths.evidence: escape.rs:49-51 `c.is_control() && c != '\t' && c != '\n'`, escape.rs:41 `write!(out, "\\u{:04x}", ...)`. `cargo test -p terminus --all-features --lib escape::` -> 3 passed, including exactly_the_controls_other_than_tab_and_newline_change, which walks U+0000..U+10FFFF and asserts 63 changed. End to end: a Bash command holding all 63 controls then `|TAB\t|NL\n|ZWSP\u200b|RLO\u202e|END`, bare-ingested, printed in human `observations` as exactly BEGIN\u0000...\u009f followed by raw tab, newline, U+200B and U+202E (probe check `observations prints the full escape set exactly` PASS); the branch printed `phase\u001bseven\u0007\u007f\u009b`. In search and the show window VT, FF, CR and NEL arrive as spaces because core's flatten collapses whitespace before the helper runs (D-08); every other control printed escaped and stdout held no byte in 0x00-0x08, 0x0b-0x1f, 0x7f or C2 80-9F.
